// why: A sibling program for the publisher's specs, on the same reasoning worker/tsconfig.json gives for the edge router: the repo-root tsconfig.json stops at `src`, and this package's own program (tsconfig.json) has to EXCLUDE the specs because it emits the deployed artifact — so without this program the publisher's only test suite would be compiled by nothing at all. Everything here is noEmit, so no setting can reach `lib/`.
// scope: The specs reach OUT of `src` on purpose — `../../src/slug` and `../../worker/src/host` are the canonical Slug rules and Namespace list the runtime mirrors — which is exactly what `rootDir: "src"` forbids in the emitting program and exactly what a parity test has to do. `vitest` is resolved from the repo-root install (nothing in router-publisher/package.json depends on it), so `moduleResolution: "bundler"` is required to read its `exports` map.
